text: Could our universe exist inside a black hole? That is Duho's personal side interest, not a NebulaMind research program. We did not measure a new star. We sealed a rule, then applied it to published pulsar measurements. The result? The Brown-Li-Rho chain examined here fails by its own second neutron star test. That does not mean every black hole universe idea is false. It means this chain lost the clean test its authors offered.
